meno_menopause_support.name: Menopause Support
meno_menopause_support.key: 500 mg EstroG‑100 herbal blend, 250 mg ashwagandha root, 80 mg black cohosh root
meno_menopause_support.dosesub: with food, same time each day
meno_menopause_support.src: Menopause Support sell sheet ND564 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAtb9A, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 1 tablet Estro G-100 blend (Angelica gigas nakai root extract, Cynanchum wilfordii root extract, Phlomis umbrosa root extract) 500 mg, ashwagandha root powder 250 mg, black cohosh root powder 80 mg; 90 servings; directions one tablet daily with food at the same time of day; caution: not for pregnancy or nursing, not recommended with known or suspected estrogen-dependent cancer. Same amounts in products DB R264L (Pendulum chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size R264L 90T from price list ND144 10/1/26. URL from Asher's Dr. Miller visit brief artifact (Revival shelf).

meno_mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
meno_mag_calm_pro.key: 200 mg magnesium (as malate), 2 g myo‑inositol, 500 mg taurine, 100 mg L‑theanine, 5 mg vitamin B6
meno_mag_calm_pro.dosesub: in 6 oz water; up to 2 a day
meno_mag_calm_pro.src: Mag Calm Pro sell sheet ND1075 Rev. 11/24 (labels.json): per scoop (4.13 g) vitamin B6 (as pyridoxal-5-phosphate) 5 mg, magnesium (as dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; about 60 servings, 247.8 g; directions 1 scoop with 6 oz water 1-2 times daily. Same amounts in products DB R2122 (Metagenics chart). URL from Asher's Dr. Miller visit brief artifact.

meno_d3_5000_k2.name: D3 5000 with K2
meno_d3_5000_k2.key: 5,000 IU (125 mcg) vitamin D3, 60 mcg vitamin K2 (MK‑7), 15 mcg vitamin K1
meno_d3_5000_k2.src: products DB R197 (Designs for Health and Ortho Molecular charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26): per softgel vitamin D3 125 mcg (5,000 IU), vitamin K2 60 mcg as MK-7, vitamin K1 15 mcg; directions take one softgel daily; size 60S (60 softgels, also printed on the bottle photo). The shared products.py entry d3_5000_k2 says capsules; the label says softgels, so this sheet uses its own entry.

meno_ultrabiotic_womens.name: UltraBiotic Women’s
meno_ultrabiotic_womens.key: 25 billion CFU from 9 strains: 7 Lactobacillus and 2 Bacillus
meno_ultrabiotic_womens.src: UltraBiotic Women's sell sheet ND1053 Rev. 1/25, opened 2026-11-03 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAwfzA): serving 2 capsules, 30 servings; strains L. acidophilus La-14, L. rhamnosus HN001, L. rhamnosus Rosell-11 + L. helveticus Rosell-52 (Lacidofil), Bacillus subtilis HU58, L. reuteri 1E1, Bacillus coagulans SC208, L. gasseri LG36, L. salivarius LS33; amounts 9 + 6 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 25 billion CFU at time of manufacture (text extraction split names and amounts; the total matches the products DB R177 Metagenics-chart read: 9 strains, 25 billion CFU per 2 capsules). Claims on the sheet: supports a healthy vaginal microbiome, supports a healthy gut microbiome. Directions take two capsules daily. No verified product-page URL, so the link falls back to catalog search.

meno_creatine.name: Creatine Powder
meno_creatine.dosesub: in 8 to 16 oz of any drink
meno_creatine.src: products DB R258 (Thorne chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26): creatine monohydrate 5 g per scoop, 100 servings, 505 g; directions mix 1 scoop in 8-16 ounces of water or your favorite beverage. Unflavored per the tub photo. URL from the repo creatine blast (blasts/2026-11-16-creatine-plus-training.html).
